text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "...To Cesario."

One day, Rhein Kraft gathered reporters 
and held a press conference.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I, Rhein Kraft, will be changing my next 
race from the second leg of the Triple 
Tiara, the Oaks, to—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm changing it to the NHK Mile Cup!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I know I really should tell them in 
person. I thought I had made up my mind, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Because in front of the best friend who 
chased the Triple Tiara alongside me for 
so long, I might get lonely and burst into 
tears."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
At first, I was aiming for the Triple 
Tiara. But as I ran in the Twinkle Series, 
I came to a realization.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Where my legs truly come alive is the 
Mile.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
In that case, going from the Oka Sho to 
the NHK Mile Cup—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to become the first Umamusume from 
the Tiara route to achieve an 
unconventional double crown!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"To tell you the truth, I really wanted to 
run the Yushun Himba with Cesario."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I thought about it over and over, and 
tried tackling it in training time after 
time, but—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it seems my legs just can't 
perform at their best over distances of 
2400m or more no matter what."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—My dream is to leave behind a memory of 
my running in someone's heart!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want the most brilliant radiance I can 
create to become a part of the light that 
guides future Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"‘That's why—I will guide Rhein Kraft to 
the place where she can shine the 
brightest.’"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "I've decided. I'm going."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
To everyone who had high hopes for my run 
along the Tiara route, I am so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Still, I promise I'll see it through!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Don't be disappointed! Be excited instead!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'd be so happy if you continue to watch 
over me from now on!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"‘We talked about our dreams so many 
times. And we promised to work hard 
together...’"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "I'm sorry, Cesario."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ... Craft... I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Thinking back on it now, her reaction 
was a bit off when we talked about the 
Oaks on the Shinkansen on our way to the 
Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her mind was surely already made up back 
then.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...You kept quiet for my sake, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So that I can run the Oka Sho without any 
hesitation...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...It would be a lie to say I'm not 
lonely. However—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Because I know how desperately she wanted 
the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I understand just 
how frustrating this decision must have 
been, so—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I will not stop you. Never.

"And so, Cesario opened the letter once 
more. Affectingly, she traced the words 
again and again as she read them."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
………… When did they find the time to write 
a letter like this?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"The place where I can shine the 
brightest," huh... I wonder when I found 
it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Realizing it, struggling, giving up. Even 
through all that, you still managed to 
find it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...My own, place...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ... Ah, no. My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Until now... I've thought over and over 
about the path I should take and what I 
must attain, but—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A "place where I can shine the 
brightest"... as if.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'd ever thought about it 
before... —Just a little.
And that night—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I-I'm home~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Cesario. Um, so... are you... mad...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry! Even on the Shinkansen, I 
feel like I was just going along with your 
pace—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just kidding...! There's no way I'd 
be mad.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Craft. ...You did your best.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "...Urgh. Come ooon, Cesario~~~."
And so, a few days later.

As if following Rhein Kraft, Daring Heart 
also announced her entry into the NHK Mile 
Cup—

Among her peers, only Cesario and Air 
Messiah were left aiming for the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: My—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm sorry. On second thought, I'll 
wait until after the Yushun Himba (Oaks) 
is over.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"It's not a crown that can be won with 
half-hearted feelings, after all."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So after the Oaks is over... I'd like to 
consult with you about something.

The ever-changing situation, and a 
promised consultation. In any case, if she 
gets distracted now, winning the Yushun 
Himba (Japanese Oaks) will certainly be 
out of reach.

Regardless, for now, just straight ahead. 
I'll simply keep letting the unchanging 
days pile up.
